tooltip.pocketkingdoms.world_anchor.more: Only the realm's owner and those on
its access list may pass, unless a
World Breacher has torn it open.
Linked, nothing can mine it; only an
Anchor Breaker can unmake it. Empty,
a diamond pickaxe lifts it in moments.
It needs room to stand: the spot above
it must hold nothing unbreakable, so
a siege can always reach it.
